name: reviewsha
description: Ревьюша — AI SaaS platform for automated code review.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web,admin,worker,omni -c blue,green,magenta,cyan,yellow "yarn workspace @reviewsha/api dev" "yarn workspace @reviewsha/web dev" "yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin dev" "yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker dev" "yarn dev:omniroute"
scripts.typecheck: yarn build:packages && yarn typecheck:packages && yarn typecheck:apps
scripts.test: yarn build:packages && yarn test:packages && yarn test:apps
scripts.clean: find apps packages -type d \( -name node_modules -o -name dist -o -name build -o -name coverage \) -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.build:packages: yarn workspace @reviewsha/config build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/types build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/sdk build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/ui build
scripts.build:apps: yarn workspace @reviewsha/api build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/web build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker build
scripts.lint:packages: yarn workspace @reviewsha/config lint && yarn workspace @reviewsha/types lint && yarn workspace @reviewsha/sdk lint && yarn workspace @reviewsha/ui lint
scripts.lint:apps: yarn workspace @reviewsha/api lint && yarn workspace @reviewsha/web lint && yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin lint && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker lint
scripts.typecheck:packages: yarn workspace @reviewsha/config build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/types build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/config typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/types typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/sdk typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/ui typecheck
scripts.typecheck:apps: yarn workspace @reviewsha/api typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/web typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker typecheck
scripts.test:packages: yarn workspace @reviewsha/config build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/types build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/config test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/types test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/sdk test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/ui test
scripts.test:apps: yarn workspace @reviewsha/api test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/web test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker test
scripts.test:stage3: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && vitest run tests/stage3 --coverage=false
scripts.ci:quality: yarn lint && yarn typecheck && yarn format:check --ignore-unknown
scripts.ci:docker: docker compose config && docker build -f apps/worker/Dockerfile -t reviewsha-worker:ci .
scripts.ci:local: yarn install --immutable --non-interactive && yarn ci:quality && yarn ci:build && yarn ci:openapi && yarn ci:unit && yarn ci:smoke && yarn ci:prisma && yarn ci:stage4 && yarn ci:stage5 && yarn ci:stage6 && yarn ci:stage7 && yarn ci:stage8 && yarn ci:stage9 && yarn ci:stage10 && yarn ci:stage11 && yarn ci:stage12 && yarn ci:stage13 && yarn ci:stage14 && yarn ci:e2e && yarn ci:docker
scripts.test:stage8: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker build && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker lint
scripts.test:stage9: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker vitest run --coverage=false
scripts.test:stage10: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api vitest run --coverage=false && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker vitest run tests/unit/reporting tests/unit/processors/ai-report.processors.test.ts --coverage=false && vitest run tests/stage10 --coverage=false
scripts.test:stage11: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api vitest run tests/unit/modules/chat tests/integration/modules/chat --coverage=false && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api vitest run tests/integration/modules/chat/chat.security.integration.test.ts tests/integration/modules/chat/chat.session-security.integration.test.ts --coverage=false && yarn workspace @reviewsha/worker vitest run tests/unit/processors/chat.processor.test.ts tests/unit/processors/processor.registry.test.ts --coverage=false
scripts.test:stage12: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api vitest run tests/unit/modules/auth tests/unit/modules/pipeline tests/integration/modules/chat --coverage=false && yarn workspace @reviewsha/web test && yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin test
scripts.test:stage13: yarn build:packages && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api prisma:generate && yarn workspace @reviewsha/api vitest run tests/unit/modules/admin tests/unit/modules/users tests/unit/modules/projects tests/integration/modules/admin/admin.security.integration.test.ts --coverage=false && yarn workspace @reviewsha/admin test
scripts.test:stage14: yarn sdk:check && yarn workspace @reviewsha/sdk typecheck && yarn workspace @reviewsha/sdk test && yarn typecheck:apps
